an3.128:1.1: [bārāṇasinidānaṃ] ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati isipatane migadāye.
an3.128:1.2: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya bārāṇasiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
an3.128:1.3: addasā kho bhagavā goyogapilakkhasmiṃ piṇḍāya caramāno aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ rittāsaṃ bāhirāsaṃ muṭṭhassatiṃ asampajānaṃ asamāhitaṃ vibbhantacittaṃ pākatindriyaṃ.
an3.128:1.4: disvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca : bhikkhu bhikkhu
an3.128:2.2: taṃ vata bhikkhu kaṭuviyakataṃ attānaṃ āmagandhe avassutaṃ makkhikā nānupatissanti, nānvāssavissantī, ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti.
an3.128:2.3: atha kho so bhikkhu bhagavatā iminā ovādena ovadito saṃvegamāpādi.
an3.128:2.4: atha kho bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto bhikkhū āmantesi :
an3.128:3.1: idāhaṃ bhikkhave, pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya bārāṇasiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ.
an3.128:3.2: addasaṃ kho ahaṃ bhikkhave, goyogapilakkhasmiṃ piṇḍāya caramāno aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ rittāsaṃ bāhirāsaṃ muṭṭhassatiṃ asampajānaṃ asamāhitaṃ vibbhantacittaṃ pākatindriyaṃ.
an3.128:4.2: taṃ vata bhikkhu kaṭuviyakataṃ attānaṃ āmagandhe avassutaṃ makkhikā nānupatissanti nānvāssavissantīti, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatī”ti.
an3.128:4.3: atha kho bhikkhave, so bhikkhu mayā iminā ovādena ovadito saṃvegamāpādīti.
an3.128:4.4: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
an3.128:5.4: taṃ vata bhikkhu, kaṭuviyaṃ kataṃ attānaṃ āmagandhe avassutaṃ makkhikā nānupatissanti nānvāssavissantīti, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti.
